headline: Internal ALB is correctly isolated, but reuses the app security group and carries unencrypted API traffic
suppressed: The internal=true flag plus private-only subnets are genuine controls against internet exposure, so the HTTP-only scheme and lack of a public IP are not flagged as network-exposure on their own. No data stores are touched, so no data-loss risk.

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf: security_groups = [aws_security_group.app.id] — the same SG is assigned to the internal ALB and the application instances
findings.explanation: Any principal already permitted to reach app instances (e.g. bastion, other VPC peers, shared-SG workloads) is implicitly allowed to address this new ALB listener; a dedicated security group for the internal ALB would limit blast radius without extra effort.

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf: protocol = "HTTP" on the new listener carrying service-to-service API calls
findings.explanation: Traffic between workers and the API is unencrypted in transit; a compromised or noisy workload elsewhere in the VPC can inspect or tamper with those calls — acceptable only if the API carries no sensitive data or mTLS is handled at the application layer.
